_comment: A histogram bin's label, as the browser (saved-chart.ts binLabel) and a workflow's message (workflow_chart_step.go chartBinLabel) both write it. saved-chart.test.ts and workflow_chart_step_test.go read these same cases, so the two cannot drift apart. An edge keeps the bin width's decimals, to at most the width's third significant digit, and is grouped in thousands: automatic bins are (max − min) / 20 wide, so their edges were written unrounded (KI-CHART-HISTOGRAM-BIN-LABELS-UNROUNDED).
